headline: Four CPA funding requests totaling $1,750,000 for Lowell housing and park projects, plus one grant extension request.
summary: The largest request is $600,000 for improvements to Oliveira Park at 85 Newhall Street and 84 Chambers Street. Mullins Management Company, Inc. also asks for a two-year extension of the MassMills IV grant agreement executed on June 25, 2024.
items: $500,000 in CPA community housing funds to be placed in the City of Lowell's Affordable Housing Trust Fund
$300,000 in CPA outdoor recreation funds for Phase 1 construction of the City's All Wheels Welcome project
$350,000 in CPA outdoor recreation funds for basketball court improvements at Eagle Park (99 Jewett Street), Hadley Park (1650 Middlesex Street), and Ducharme Park (367 Woburn Ave)
$600,000 in CPA outdoor recreation funds for improvements to Oliveira Park at 85 Newhall Street and 84 Chambers Street
Extension request for the MassMills IV grant agreement at 169.1 and 169.2 Bridge Street, asking for two more years
location: Mayor's Reception Room, 375 Merrimack Street, Lowell MA 01852
plain_text:
City of Lowell – Community  
Preservation Committee 
 
Community Preservation Committee  
Thursday, December 3, 2026 at 6:30 p.m. 
 
Meetings will be held in the Mayor ’s Reception Room at 375 Merrimack Street , 
Lowell MA 01852 with public welcome and by using remote participation as follows:   
 
Members of the public may view the meeting via ltc.org or local cable channel 6. 
Those wishing to speak regarding a specific agenda item shall register to speak in 
advance of the meeting by sending an email to dricker@lowellma.gov , 
mbrundage@lowellma.gov AND pcutrumbes@lowellma.gov indicating the agenda 
item and a phone number to call so that you may be issued zoom link to the meeting. 
If no access to email, you may contact Development Services at 978 -674-4144. All 
requests must occur prior to 4:00PM on the day of meeting.  
 
For help with zoom please visit: Joining a Zoom meeting – Zoom Support 
 
       Review all application documents online at: https://www.lowellma.gov/1531/Community-Preservation-Committee  
 
I. Minutes for Approval 
 
 11/5/2026 Meeting Minutes 
 
II. New Business 
   
CPA Application – Affordable Housing Trust Fund 
An application has been submitted by the City of Lowell seeking $500,000 of CPA community housing funding to 
be placed in the City of Lowell’s Affordable Housing Trust Fund. 
 
CPA Application – All Wheels Welcome Program 
An application has been submitted by the City’s Department of Planning and Development, seeking $300,000 of 
CPA outdoor recreation funding for the Phase 1 construction of the City’s All Wheels Welcome project. 
 
CPA Application – Eagle Park (99 Jewett Street), Hadley Park (1650 Middlesex Street), Ducharme Park (367 
Woburn Ave) 
An application has been submitted by the City’s Department of Planning and Development, seeking $350,000 of 
CPA outdoor recreation funding for improvements to the basketball courts at Eagle Park, Hadley Park, and 
Ducharme Park.  
 
CPA Application – Oliveira Park (85 Newhall Street and 84 Chambers Street) 
An application has been submitted by the City’s Department of Planning and Development, seeking $600,000 of 
CPA outdoor recreation funding for improvements to Oliveira Park located at 85 Newhall Street and 84 
Chambers Street.
Extension Request – 169.1 and 169.2 Bridge Street (MassMills IV)  
Mullins Management Company, Inc. is requesting a 2-year extension be granted for the MassMills IV grant 
agreement executed on June 25, 2024. 
 
 
III. Continued Business 
 
IV. Other Business 
 
  Election of Officers

VII. Adjournment
